source.prompt: Indie dance song, about 3.5 minutes, 113 BPM, B minor. Dreamy, warm late-summer night drive with a bittersweet glow and an uplifting chorus. Soft, smooth female lead vocal, close and breathy in the verses, open and warm in the chorus, with gentle layered harmonies on the hook. Warm sustained analog synth lead, lush string pad, mellow Rhodes chords, soft round synth bass with long notes. Smooth, soft four-on-the-floor kick, brushed snare on 2 and 4, soft shaker, airy offbeat hats. Structure: instrumental intro (16 bars), verse, pre-chorus, chorus, short instrumental break, verse 2, chorus, stripped bridge, final chorus, instrumental outro that fades. Clean, warm, wide mix with soft, smooth transients and a tight mono low end.
source.lyrics:
[Intro]
Mm, mm

[Verse]
Windows down on the coast road
Summer's fading into gold
You keep the radio humming low
Like a secret we were told

[Pre-Chorus]
Don't look back, the sun is sinking
Hold the wheel and stop your thinking

[Chorus]
We ride the afterglow
Wherever the night will go
Your hand in mine, the city slow
We ride, we ride the afterglow

[Verse]
Paper cups and a borrowed jacket
Streetlights blinking one by one
Every mile is a little closer
To the place where we begun

[Pre-Chorus]
Don't look back, the sun is sinking
Hold the wheel and stop your thinking

[Chorus]
We ride the afterglow
Wherever the night will go
Your hand in mine, the city slow
We ride, we ride the afterglow

[Bridge]
Stay a little longer
Let the evening breathe
All the stars are coming
Just for you and me

[Chorus]
We ride the afterglow
Wherever the night will go
Your hand in mine, the city slow
We ride, we ride the afterglow
